note: Parts too big for your 3D printer are now split for you: set your machine in Preferences → 3D printing and an oversized nose cone or tube exports as a zip of numbered segments joined by a printed spigot, with a print-and-glue README. A 3" nose cone becomes two pieces. Nothing changes if you don't set a printer. Also: a "Fit rocket to frame" option on the 3D image export, so an 8K export is 8K of rocket — and the site menu no longer wraps to two rows on laptops.
